tool_args.rationale: The base-field, sink-gradient, and transient-lag signatures jointly favor the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE. The fine trajectory batch adds within-trajectory timing information to separate fast memory relaxation from coupling before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE to the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoints at similar horizons leave no residual degrees of freedom and weakly distinguish memory coupling from its relaxation time.
It captures sink inhibition but omits the observed transient lag and dependence on the initial state.
It does not resolve the transient dynamics.
